source.content: Lead firstLead = new Lead(FirstName = 'Ada', LastName = 'Lovelace', Company = 'Analytical Engines', Status = 'Open'); insert firstLead; Database.LeadConvert firstConvert = new Database.LeadConvert(); firstConvert.setLeadId(firstLead.Id); firstConvert.setConvertedStatus('Qualified'); firstConvert.setDoNotCreateOpportunity(true); Database.LeadConvertResult first = Database.convertLead(firstConvert, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assert(first.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(true, first.success); System.assertEquals(firstLead.Id, first.getLeadId()); System.assertEquals(firstLead.Id, first.leadId); System.assertNotEquals(null, first.getAccountId()); System.assertEquals(first.getAccountId(), first.accountId); System.assertNotEquals(null, first.getContactId()); System.assertEquals(first.getContactId(), first.contactId); System.assertEquals(null, first.getOpportunityId()); System.assertEquals(0, first.getErrors().size()); System.assertEquals(first.errors.size(), first.getErrors().size()); System.assert(first.equals(first)); System.assertNotEquals(0, first.hashCode()); System.assert(first.toString().contains('LeadConvertResult')); Lead convertedFirst = [SELECT IsConverted, ConvertedAccountId, ConvertedContactId FROM Lead WHERE Id = :firstLead.Id]; System.assert(convertedFirst.IsConverted); System.assertEquals(first.getAccountId(), convertedFirst.ConvertedAccountId); System.assertEquals(first.getContactId(), convertedFirst.ConvertedContactId); Account firstAccount = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id = :first.getAccountId()]; Contact firstContact = [SELECT Id, LastName, AccountId FROM Contact WHERE Id = :first.getContactId()]; System.assertEquals('Analytical Engines', firstAccount.Name); System.assertEquals('Lovelace', firstContact.LastName); System.assertEquals(firstAccount.Id, firstContact.AccountId); Lead secondLead = new Lead(FirstName = 'Grace', LastName = 'Hopper', Company = 'Compilers Inc', Status = 'Open'); insert secondLead; Database.LeadConvert secondConvert = new Database.LeadConvert(); secondConvert.setLeadId(secondLead.Id); secondConvert.setConvertedStatus('Qualified'); secondConvert.setOpportunityName('Compiler Sale'); Database.LeadConvertResult second = Database.convertLead(secondConvert, new Database.DMLOptions(), AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assert(second.isSuccess()); System.assertNotEquals(null, second.getOpportunityId()); Opportunity secondOpportunity = [SELECT Id, Name, AccountId FROM Opportunity WHERE Id = :second.getOpportunityId()]; System.assertEquals('Compiler Sale', secondOpportunity.Name); System.assertEquals(second.getAccountId(), secondOpportunity.AccountId); Lead thirdLead = new Lead(FirstName = 'Katherine', LastName = 'Johnson', Company = 'NASA', Status = 'Open'); Lead fourthLead = new Lead(FirstName = 'Dorothy', LastName = 'Vaughan', Company = 'NASA', Status = 'Open'); insert new List<Lead>{thirdLead, fourthLead}; Database.LeadConvert thirdConvert = new Database.LeadConvert(); thirdConvert.setLeadId(thirdLead.Id); thirdConvert.setConvertedStatus('Qualified'); thirdConvert.setDoNotCreateOpportunity(true); Database.LeadConvert fourthConvert = new Database.LeadConvert(); fourthConvert.setLeadId(fourthLead.Id); fourthConvert.setConvertedStatus('Qualified'); fourthConvert.setDoNotCreateOpportunity(true); List<Database.LeadConvertResult> listResults = Database.convertLead(new List<Database.LeadConvert>{thirdConvert, fourthConvert}, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, listResults.size()); System.assert(listResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(listResults[1].isSuccess()); Lead fifthLead = new Lead(FirstName = 'Mary', LastName = 'Jackson', Company = 'NASA', Status = 'Open'); Lead sixthLead = new Lead(FirstName = 'Annie', LastName = 'Easley', Company = 'NASA', Status = 'Open'); insert new List<Lead>{fifthLead, sixthLead}; Database.LeadConvert fifthConvert = new Database.LeadConvert(); fifthConvert.setLeadId(fifthLead.Id); fifthConvert.setConvertedStatus('Qualified'); fifthConvert.setDoNotCreateOpportunity(true); Database.LeadConvert sixthConvert = new Database.LeadConvert(); sixthConvert.setLeadId(sixthLead.Id); sixthConvert.setConvertedStatus('Qualified'); sixthConvert.setDoNotCreateOpportunity(true); List<Database.LeadConvertResult> optionResults = Database.convertLead(new List<Database.LeadConvert>{fifthConvert, sixthConvert}, new Database.DMLOptions(), AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, optionResults.size()); System.assert(optionResults[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(optionResults[1].isSuccess()); List<Lead> converted = [SELECT IsConverted FROM Lead WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{thirdLead.Id, fourthLead.Id, fifthLead.Id, sixthLead.Id}]; System.assertEquals(4, converted.size()); for (Lead row : converted) System.assert(row.IsConverted);
